C4S079.raw_value: Let future real increments be independent and individually symmetric about zero. Write S<sub>h</sub> for their partial sums, S<sub>0</sub>=0, and fix an observed starting position x with B=|x|. No identical-distribution or finite-moment assumption is required. If q is the population (1−α/2) quantile of |S<sub>H</sub>|, the report B+q has strict peak-breach probability at most α. This is a direct scalar application of the classical Lévy maximal inequality, not a new inequality.
